name: Mean Girls Graduation Day 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Mean Girls Graduation Day is a stylish dress-up adventure where you glam up Ava, Ellie, Selena, and Riri for the fiercest graduation shoot ever. Mix bold looks across trendy styles—from preppy to pastel—then finish each makeover with makeup, robes, and a selfie-worthy photo booth finale.
